How It Works

Intelligent by design.

01☀️

Solar Charged by Day

Integrated solar panel harvests daylight into Lithium Chemistry batteries. Dual solar + micro-USB backup. Zero running costs. Perpetual readiness.

02🌙

Auto-Activates at Dusk

Switches on at nightfall, off at dawn automatically. No manual operation. Guards when animals are most active — every single night without fail.

03💡

360° White Starburst Flash

Four powerful LEDs fire randomised white starburst patterns across 360°. Visible up to 250m. Exploits hardwired predator aversion to sudden light.

04🌡️

−40° to +60°C Range

Engineered for every Indian climate — Ladakh winters and Rajasthan summers. Works across every terrain without performance compromise.

05📍

Mount Anywhere

Compact pole-mounted design. No electrician, no cables, no infrastructure. Deploy at any farm perimeter in minutes with zero technical skill.

06🛡️

Non-Lethal. Always.

Deters without harm. Preserving wildlife while protecting livelihoods — conservation and coexistence by design, not compromise.

Our Story

Engineering with purpose.

Katidhan was founded on a simple belief: that technology can resolve conflict without cruelty. Every year, thousands of farmers across India lose their crops, livestock — and sometimes their livelihoods — to wildlife. Meanwhile, animals are killed in retaliation. We decided there had to be a better way.

We are a Bengaluru-based deep-tech startup recognized by Startup India and Startup Karnataka, winners of the Government of Karnataka's Elevate 2019 grant, and proud alumni of Shark Tank India Season 3.

Our flagship product, Parabraksh, has been deployed across 12 Indian states, protecting over 1,600 farming families with zero animal attacks reported.

We believe in coexistence. Parabraksh doesn't hurt animals — it simply teaches them that some boundaries are not worth crossing.
